step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture shows a video transcoding workflow. A user/backend triggers the Scheduler (EC2), which coordinates with the Master node (EC2). The Master node pulls source video files from an Input S3 bucket, splices them into small segments, and distributes processing jobs to worker nodes (EC2 spot instances inside a Kubernetes cluster). Once workers complete transcoding, segments are returned to the Master node, which stitches them together and uploads the final video to an Output S3 bucket.
